# P1: port audio keys after S10's sound.dll renames (HEAD 4a60a0b2)

## Cause
S10 (613976b3, 32aeab6b) named 43 sound.dll functions the port registered as `snd.FUN_<va>` (all in audio_exe.cpp's kSndExtra /
FuncDef table) and changed hooks.csv, so test_audio_names refused the FUN_ keys and soundstate.h (kSoundFunctions) was stale.

## Edits (log/roadmap/P1/edits.py, 28 anchored edits in 5 files; generated by make_edits.py from the mirror)
- port/include/portsim/sim/soundstate.h: regenerated with re/tools/soundstate_gen.py (kSoundFunctions 744 -> 1,315 rows).
- port/src/sim/audio_exe.cpp: the 43 FUN_<va> tokens -> their hooks.csv names (rename_map.json; 127 tokens: kSndExtra, FuncDef
  rows, comments).
- port/test/test_audio_exe.py: device negctl parameter snd.FUN_1000e830 -> snd.Wave_Device::get_rate.
- port/test/test_audio_names.py: the "unnamed function" example is now FUN_10029e30 (still unnamed); FUN_1000e810 added as a
  refused case (Wave_Device::set_rate).
- re/roadmap/S4_functions.tsv: 12 rows of step `-` (unported, unregistered) take hooks.csv's names (Ctrl5b5f0_ctor ->
  Randomizer::ctor, crtValidatePointer -> _ValidateWrite, ...).

## Behaviour unchanged: proof
- lookup_sim.py simulates audio_core lookup_port (kSoundFunctions with `collides`, then audio_crt kNames, audio_exe kSndExtra)
  for all 1,346 rvas in HEAD and in the mirror: 706 resolve in each, 0 resolve to a different port function (renames mapped).
  The regenerated header also flips `collides` to true for operator_delete / strstr / free / _unlock (S10 added exe rows of
  those names); kNames resolves them to the same registered functions, so dispatch is equal.
- golden_keys.py: every port/test/golden_*.json equal to HEAD's (no golden key holds an old FUN_ name; 0 files differ).

## Gates (mirror port/build/P1 = git archive 4a60a0b2 + edits.py; build.sh, gates.sh; logs g_*.log)
- build x64 + Win32 (FreeType) rc 0.
- audio_x64: 13 / 13 test_audio_* files PASS (test_audio_core 146 passed incl. test_soundstate_header_current; test_audio_names
  12 passed; test_audio_exe 302 passed incl. the $device stream digest). audio_win32 (SG_BACKEND=win32): 13 / 13 PASS.
- port test_static 6 / 6. segments 205 / 205 x64, every status and digest equal to I18's segs_x64.tsv (segs_vs_I18.log).
- boot x64 66 PASS / 2 KNOWN / 2 NO_FRAMES, every row equal to I18's boot_x64.tsv (boot_vs_I18.log).
- HEAD moved to a5419a66 (S9) during the work; none of the five files or the generator inputs differ from 4a60a0b2. edits.py
  applies to a clean archive of a5419a66 too (28 / 28), soundstate_gen.py --check reports current there, and the naming check
  over its 1,271 FuncDef rows (net modules included) finds nothing.

## Not edited, keyed on old names (for the lead)
- The 43 FUN_ names: no reference in shim/src/re, re/frida or re/tools (only test_audio_names' refused case, on purpose).
- S10 renames hooks.csv applied without port keys (these 12 old names are unregistered in the port, now renamed in
  S4_functions.tsv): iosResetVtable (shim c3cm.cpp, c3cx.cpp; re/frida registry.d c3cm.py / c3cx.py, fixtures.d c3cm.js),
  ostreamResetVtable (shim c3cm.cpp, c3cx.cpp; registry.d c3cx.py, fixtures.d c3cx.js), sbhPageFree (shim c3cx.cpp; registry.d
  c3cx.py, fixtures.d c3cx.js), crtValidatePointer (shim c3cm.cpp, c3fd_negctl.cpp; registry.d c3cm.py / c3fd.py, fixtures.d
  c3cm.js / c3fd.js); re/roadmap/S4_census.tsv keys crtValidatePointer, iosResetVtable, ostreamResetVtable, sbhPageFree (registry
  keys). Rows are looked up by address, so these are spellings only.
- D1 deferred renames (log/roadmap/S10/9_renames_sound.tsv): 15 rows whose old name the port registers and hooks.csv still holds
  (Sound5b6a8_ctor / _dtor, Sound5c450_ctor / _dtor, Ctrl5b5c0_ctor, Ctrl5b668_ctor, Ctrl5b19c_ctor, Ch5bb90_dtor, Ch5c178_ctor /
  _dtor, Ch5c234_dtor, Ch5c2ec_dtor, Ch5be88_ctor / _dtorA, Ch5c3a4_ctor; Ch5bb90_ctor is in hooks.csv only). Consistent today.

## Reproduce
sh log/roadmap/P1/build.sh; sh log/roadmap/P1/gates.sh audio_x64 audio_win32 port_static segs_x64 boot_x64;
~/bin/py -3.12 log/roadmap/P1/golden_keys.py; ~/bin/py -3.12 log/roadmap/P1/lookup_sim.py <HEAD archive> port/build/P1
log/roadmap/P1/rename_map.json. Controls: test_audio_names' new refused case (FUN_1000e810 RED); no behaviour changed.
